testingVerificationStrategy.result: Mapped Browser SQL contracts to Node deterministic tests, real Chromium Worker/Wasm/OPFS/runtime/Viewer integration tests and authenticated-Leumi live verification for real page CSP/origin/provider behavior.
testingVerificationStrategy.criticalLiveGate: Before heavy Browser SQL implementation, prove on the real authenticated Leumi page with synthetic data: injected JS/Bookmarklet → Blob Worker → pinned DuckDB Worker/Wasm → OPFS write+COMMIT+CHECKPOINT → refresh/reopen.
testingVerificationStrategy.ci: Fast Node CI remains normal push/PR gate; targeted Chromium is used during browser TDD/debugging; full Browser CI is required for browser-dependent Stage closure and runtime publication.

githubExecutionRequirement.rule: The planning project must end with real executable GitHub Issues and, where supported/useful, milestones, labels and dependency/parent-child structure. Markdown planning alone is not the final deliverable.
githubExecutionRequirement.plannedPhases: P implementation decomposition, Q GitHub execution structure, R final plan audit

verification.specImpact: No runtime code or normative implemented spec changed. Phase N defines target migration/cutover planning only.

hotContextBudgetRepair.cause: Phase D-L summaries accumulated in AI_CONTEXT.md and broke the 5000-character hot-context guard.
hotContextBudgetRepair.fix: AI_CONTEXT.md reduced to compact continuation context; detailed phase content remains in phase artifacts. Guard unchanged.
hotContextBudgetRepair.prevention: Do not append phase summaries to HOT context; add only compact references/contracts and let the existing budget guard enforce the limit.

performanceBenchmarkStrategy.result: Selected parameterized synthetic Browser SQL benchmarks covering durable ingest+CHECKPOINT, representative SQL, mixed LIVE load, memory, OPFS growth, reopen and hidden/background behavior with full-session and 2x-session capacity evidence.
performanceBenchmarkStrategy.environment: Primary decision evidence is representative Windows + Chrome/Chromium; Linux CI timings are regression/trend evidence only.
performanceBenchmarkStrategy.implementation: Benchmark harness remains deferred to implementation Issues.

migrationCutover.authorityTransition: IndexedDB remains sole authority during optional isolated SQL shadow verification; cutover occurs at an explicit settled-cycle boundary, after which fresh production OPFS is the only active market-history authority.
migrationCutover.legacyHistory: Initial cutover intentionally does not import IndexedDB history. SQL horizon history starts fresh and warms naturally; the old IndexedDB remains inert as rollback/diagnostic data.
migrationCutover.rollback: No silent runtime fallback. Explicit rollback preserves OPFS and launches the retained IndexedDB release, accepting a documented gap for the SQL-only interval.
migrationCutover.cleanup: Legacy IndexedDB and migration scaffolding are not automatically deleted; cleanup happens only after an explicit stabilization decision.

next.action: Planning Phase O: design failure taxonomy, security hardening and observability.
steps: Define failure classes across provider, validation, Worker/bootstrap, SQL, OPFS, scheduler, Viewer and migration boundaries.
Define which failures are recoverable, retryable, blocking or require explicit user/admin intervention.
Finalize secret/security boundaries for user SQL, generated artifacts, diagnostics and live verification.
Define structured diagnostics/health state and minimum observability fields without leaking sensitive session data.
Define alert/status precedence and how failures remain visible without corrupting latest successful state.
Define acceptance scenarios that implementation Issues must satisfy.

history.rule: Superseded architecture/research plans remain cold history and do not carry current progress.
